calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-20-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor in Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vnatree, CSR: S. Wong # 11288
Petitioner HENRY BITTNER, father was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor JOSHUA CEDAR THOR BITTNER.

Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.

Minor's mother, ROXANA CHOWDHURY was not present, court proceeded with hearing.

Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to THOR CEDAR BITTNER.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
